anchorReview.visual: The established COLOR ARRIVAL v4 loader and canonical Audralia world remain visually unchanged. The repair changes startup ownership only: the canonical renderer/reconciliation now executes before optional atmospheric, celestial, and composition enrichment.
anchorReview.interaction: Camera, look, travel, zoom, world navigation, terrain, coastline, and canonical weather interaction semantics are unchanged. The world becomes interactive as soon as the already-qualified canonical renderer is viable; optional enrichment attaches afterward.
anchorReview.continuity: This restores the renderer-first behavior of the previously successful Audralia promotion lineage while retaining the newer dense ACF1/FAP1 cloud, volumetric depth, orbital support, organized weather, celestial, and composition modules. Optional enrichment may report its own failure but cannot hold world entry hostage.
